items.issue: P3 optimum changed during the card
items.evidence: 022d supersedes 022c; 034 uses older inventories.
items.resolution_needed: Use P3-LATEST for a buy; re-inventory vacuum at final selected geometry.

items.issue: No finished thin SR200 compression minimum
items.evidence: 036; catalog 345 MPa is tensile.
items.resolution_needed: Obtain lot/gauge/process specification and directional plus biaxial evidence.

items.issue: Nominal thickness is not finished minimum
items.evidence: 036 shows catalog tolerances and processing alter demand.
items.resolution_needed: Measure thickness map and track additional removal without double-counting catalog etch.

items.issue: Uniaxial tests may censor the required wrinkle evidence
items.evidence: Current equal-biaxial threshold needs approximately 440 MPa uniaxial wrinkle onset if inherited b applies.
items.resolution_needed: Separate face yield from wrinkles; test equal-biaxial panel and actual orthotropy.

items.issue: Thin film, primer and repairs have no demonstrated installed mass
items.evidence: 028b nominal route has no unused joining allowance.
items.resolution_needed: Weigh staged actual-process components; apply area/length/crossing model once.

items.issue: Mean shear does not qualify peel, cyclic debond or local instability
items.evidence: 028b lists unquantified seam/core modes.
items.resolution_needed: Instrument production scarf and welded alternatives; retain failure locations and leak changes.

items.issue: Gamma denominators differ across models and shorthand
items.evidence: 029 brief versus 021b/028b finite-core convention.
items.resolution_needed: Report collapse/reference pressures explicitly; preserve both FE and inherited normalizations.

items.issue: Smallest manufactured similarity shell not established
items.evidence: Planning floors 25 um/1 mm are assumptions; commercial microcore/formed foil combination unverified.
items.resolution_needed: Gate the surrogate on measured moduli, gauge and a fabrication trial; no Be-hull validation claim.

items.issue: Stock honeycomb cells do not scale with a miniature shell
items.evidence: At R=.5m exact cellular similarity requires .47625mm cells.
items.resolution_needed: Use custom cells or identify continuous-core model scope; separately validate real honeycomb local modes.

items.issue: Maximum dent alone does not preserve buckling similarity
items.evidence: 021b localized amplitude map is not RMS or 028b qualification.
items.resolution_needed: Measure full spatial field, angular width, seams and as-built mode sensitivity.

items.issue: Ambient evacuation gives little Be overload and censored survivals
items.evidence: 101.325kPa maximum is only 1.06143 times the R10 design pressure.
items.resolution_needed: Use differential metrology and external-pressure facility where collapse/proof exceeds ambient.

items.issue: No complete qualified high-strength gas-tight laminate supplied
items.evidence: 024, 030, 022d; filament data are not a complete membrane.
items.resolution_needed: Identify and weigh both plies, barrier, attachment, seams; test sustained biaxial response and transport.

items.issue: Small compression specimens do not establish full curved SiC reliability
items.evidence: 025 and C1424 scope; no compression size law or full product specification. 022d also assumes an unqualified 15.586 MPa tensile ceiling.
items.resolution_needed: Stage process witnesses, representative stubs, loaded contacts and full arcs; qualify tensile/contact response where present and build statistical model.

items.issue: Required P3 rotation/roll stiffness is unknown
items.evidence: 026 free-roll mechanisms; 022d joints have axial/bond sizing only.
items.resolution_needed: Measure loaded stiffness matrix and define acceptance by exact discrete-frame sweeps.

items.issue: Fractional optimized node counts are not buildable frames
items.evidence: 022d one-member half-wave screen does not validate continuum; two-way shear stiffness unresolved.
items.resolution_needed: Select integer topology and re-evaluate before manufacturing; test pressure-skin load sharing.

items.issue: Every core cell/tube bore must be evacuated or charged
items.evidence: 034 estimates substantial ambient trapped gas.
items.resolution_needed: Measure communication, initial inventory, transient gas release and structural impact of vents.

items.issue: Pressure, free gas and added mass are different constraints
items.evidence: 034: water pressure, finite desorption and external uptake differ.
items.resolution_needed: Measure species and temperature, retain outgas pressure but do not double-count solid mass; use hot pressure limit.

items.issue: Sealed life and pumping hardware are not determined by a helium leak rate
items.evidence: 034 example 91.6-111.6kg Zylon package; inventories differ from current points.
items.resolution_needed: Update complete bill and installed pump speed/power at measured service load; retain 100kg allowance.

items.issue: All prices and custom fabrication feasibility are projections
items.evidence: No contact, quote, laboratory Be acceptance or minimum-order confirmation.
items.resolution_needed: Admiral decides outreach; cost the specified specimen package, shared stock and follow-ons.

items.issue: Screening count is not a design allowable or mission qualification
items.evidence: Three to ten specimens only screen large errors; size/lot/lifetime transfer unresolved.
items.resolution_needed: Define required reliability and confidence, then qualify lots, environments, damage and life.
